newsitem.title: USA: FPA Medical delays shareholder meeting.
newsitem.headline: FPA Medical delays shareholder meeting.

text.p: FPA Medical Management Inc said on Wednesday a shareholder meeting to approve a proposed merger with Sterling Healthcare Group Inc and a deal with Foundation Health Corp has been dalayed one month and now will be held in October.

"The mailing of the proxy statement and the special meeting have been delayed by approximately one month due to a routine review by the Securities and Exchange Commission," said Steven Lash, FPA chief financial officer.
FPA and Foundation have entered a management agreement, which will become effective prior to FPA's acquisition of 30 healthcare centers from Foundation, FPA said.
Effective October 1, FPA will begin managing Foundation's healthcare centers in California and Arizona, which provide services to about 275,000 HMO members.
Following completion of the Sterling and Foundation deals, FPA is expected to expand its service area to 24 states.
FPA also said it had signed a five-year administrative services agreement with Wake Primary Care Physicians, PA., a private practice in North Carolina.
